Frequently asked questions

How do I make a booking?

Please check our availability calendar, then send us an enquiry using the contact form with your preferred dates. We will review your request and reply as soon as possible.

If your requested dates are available, we will provide the booking and payment details. Your booking will be confirmed, and the dates secured, only once the 30% deposit has been received and verified in our bank account and we have sent you written confirmation.

What is the minimum stay?

The minimum stay is four nights. Shorter stays may occasionally be considered on a case-by-case basis, subject to availability and confirmation.

How many guests can the house accommodate?

The house comfortably accommodates four guests. A fifth guest may occasionally be accommodated on request.

Is the house suitable for children?

For safety reasons, the property is not suitable for children under five years of age.

What time are check-in and checkout?

Check-in is available from 15:00 and checkout is by 10:00. Early check-in or late checkout may occasionally be possible on request, subject to availability and confirmation.

Guests check in and out independently using the lockbox. Detailed directions and lockbox instructions will be sent before arrival.

How is payment made?

A 30% deposit is required by bank transfer to confirm the booking.

The remaining accommodation balance and the climate tax are payable upon arrival.

Is the climate tax included in the accommodation price?

No. The climate tax is a tourist tax imposed by the Greek government. Accommodation hosts are required to collect it on the government's behalf and pay it to the Greek state in full. It is charged separately from the accommodation price and is payable as stated in the booking terms.

What is the cancellation policy?
  • Cancellations made 60 days or more before arrival receive a full refund of the deposit.
  • Cancellations made 30 to 59 days before arrival receive a refund of 50% of the deposit.
  • Cancellations made less than 30 days before arrival are non-refundable.

We recommend that guests arrange suitable travel insurance to cover unexpected changes, illness or travel disruption.

Is parking available?

Yes. Free on-street parking is available outside the house.

How far is the house from the village square and the beach?

Liapades village square is approximately seven minutes away on foot.

The nearest beach is around fifteen minutes' walk from the house.

Is public transport available?

Yes. Liapades is served by the A10 Green Bus route, which connects the village with Corfu Town.

Timetables and service frequency may vary according to the season and day of the week, so we recommend checking the official timetable shortly before travelling.

Corfu City Bus operates local routes within Corfu Town and the surrounding urban area.

View the A10 Liapades bus timetable →
View Corfu City Bus information →

Do I need a car?

A car is not essential for enjoying Liapades village.

However, it may be useful if you wish to explore Corfu Town, more distant beaches and the traditional villages of the surrounding area.

Is Wi-Fi available?

Yes. Wi-Fi is available throughout the house.

Is the house air-conditioned?

Yes. Both bedrooms have air conditioning. Heating is also available.

Is the kitchen equipped for everyday cooking?

Yes. The kitchen includes an oven, electric cooker, fridge, freezer, microwave, kettle, toaster, espresso machine, filter coffee maker, cooking basics and a selection of glassware.

Is a washing machine available?

Yes. A washing machine, clothes-drying rack, iron and ironing board are provided.

Are pets permitted?

Pets are not permitted, except for service animals.

Is smoking permitted?

Smoking is not permitted inside the house.

Smoking is allowed on the balconies. Guests are kindly asked to use the ashtrays provided and ensure that cigarettes are fully extinguished.

Is additional cleaning available during the stay?

Yes. Additional cleaning may be arranged on request, subject to availability.

Is the house accessible?

The house is located on the first floor and is reached by stairs.

There is also one internal step between the open-plan living area and the bedroom wing.

Guests with specific accessibility requirements are welcome to contact us before booking so that we can provide further information.

Are longer stays available?

Yes. Longer stays may be considered, subject to availability and the time of year. A reduced accommodation rate may be available for extended bookings.

Please contact us with your preferred dates, the number of guests and any particular requirements, and we will be pleased to provide a tailored quotation.

When is the best time to visit Corfu?

Corfu offers a different experience throughout the year.

For warm weather, swimming and long days by the sea, late May to September is generally the most suitable period. May, June and September are particularly appealing for guests who prefer warm weather and a quieter atmosphere than the peak weeks of July and August.

Spring brings green landscapes and flowering countryside, while Easter is one of the island's most distinctive cultural celebrations.

Autumn is well suited to walking, village life and exploring the island at a slower pace.

Winter is peaceful and exceptionally green, although rainfall is more frequent and some seasonal businesses may be closed.

What travel documents do I need to visit Corfu?

Entry requirements depend on your nationality and personal circumstances.

Citizens of the European Union may generally travel to Greece with a valid passport or national identity card. Visitors from outside the European Union require a valid passport and may also require a visa, depending on their nationality and the length and purpose of their stay.

As requirements may change, guests should consult the relevant official authorities before travelling.
